name: Triangular Matrix Data Redistribution
definition: A data redistribution technique that categorizes volume data blocks into a triangular matrix of buckets based on their functional value range [Vmin, Vmax] to ensure load balancing during parallel isosurface extraction.
summary: Triangular Matrix Data Redistribution is a greedy algorithm that balances parallel isosurface extraction by categorizing volume blocks into a triangular matrix of buckets based on their value ranges and spans.
